dataset.primary_task: beat_mkt_20d (20-session next-open excess vs universe median)
dataset.label_warning: y_*/fwd_*/label_* use FUTURE prices -- train targets only, never features
dataset.known_gaps: prices unadjusted (no CA feed in sandbox): y_clean_20d masks split-contaminated 20d labels; carry/announcement features need F&O/announcement feeds not present in this repo

design.cv: moving blocks of 20 consecutive sessions over the pooled, chronological sequence of the 43 folds' test dates (circular at the ends; audit T14 _block_counts with L=20 on the pooled sequence); identical draws for every model (paired). cv_mean replicate = sum_f mult_f * AUC_f(w) / sum_f mult_f with mult_f = (draw weight of fold f's dates)/(fold f's dates); pooled_cv replicate = weighted AUC over all CV rows (scores of 43 fold models pooled, as ml/eval_aggregate.py does)
design.holdout: 20-session circular blocks inside the 32-date holdout (seed 109): ~2 blocks per replicate, so the holdout CI is indicative only

definition.direction: sign of the equal-weight universe's forward 20-day return (mean over the month's signal dates of the EW mean y_raw_20d of clean-labeled universe rows) -- what a passive 20-day tranche earned
definition.volatility: annualised std of the EW universe's daily close-to-close return (mean ret_1d over the date's universe rows, |ret_1d| > 22% split/CA days excluded) over the month's sessions; high = above the median of the 43 CV months (the same threshold classifies the holdout months)
definition.top_decile_excess_vs_ew_20d: per date: mean y_raw_20d of the top 10% by score minus the EW universe, gross of costs; averaged over the month's dates
definition.inverted_share: share of the 42 value features (40 base + 2 sufficiency, *_isnan excluded) whose monthly mean rank-IC vs y_excess_20d has the opposite sign to the feature's 43-month mean (descriptive orientation, not PIT)
